mechanisms.name: dislocation accumulation at silicide and α/β interfaces

evidence.quote: the S2 and β phases are signiﬁcantly harder than the α phase at high temperatures, and thus the slip of dislocations is inhibited at the silicide and α/ β phase boundaries leading to dislocation plugging

mechanisms.name: boundary restriction of dislocation accumulation by lamellar structure

evidence.quote: The alloy shows mini- mal softening at high temperatures due to the grain boundaries in the lamellar structure, which increase the total grain bound- ary area, reduce dislocation accumulation

mechanisms.name: silicide precipitation due to reduced Si solubility during β→α transition

evidence.quote: This is because Si is a β-stable el- ement, the β-phase provides more diffusion channels, and the β to α transition reduces the solubility of Si increasing the chemi- cal driving force for the precipitation of silicides [ 29 ].

mechanisms.name: crack path tortuosity by interlayered α and pinned silicides

evidence.quote: The lamellar microstructure is distributed with interlay- ered α phases, and these α communities provide more α/ β phase boundaries, which “restrain” each other, making the crack exten- sion path more tortuous, and the hard silicides will be pinned to the matrix during the crack extension process
